name: Frostbite
note: Hand-captured on 2026-11-02, the day before release, by parsing the notes' raw HTML to text, not by summarizing them. The notes head the balance Eternal sections and every item with an image only: Eternal attributions are verified against data/game-data/eternals.json (every 'from' value in the notes matches our stored 1.17.2 text), and item names are read from each section's banner image filename. The Overclocked section (Renna and Sevarog stacks, crest stacks, Lucky Feather, Catalytic Drive, Nihil, Vesh, Aion gold, objective timers, minion health) is a limited-time mode's ruleset and is NOT a ranked change; it is filed under systems only. Kaelen ships in this patch but is absent from data/catalog until pred.gg publishes 1.18.
global: New hero Kaelen, a melee frontliner with twin greatswords who leaves Rimeglass under every ability; enemies standing on it take Frostbite (a 15% slow and 0.5% max health true damage every 0.5s).
Ranked Split 5 ends on release day and everyone re-places (5 matches, 10 if new or returning); a new Master tier sits between Diamond I and Paragon, and Paragon becomes the top 100 players only.

Two new frontline items: Vortex Stone (support, 2350g) refunds 20% of basic cooldowns and shields on immobilizing a hero; Forticus (tank, 2900g) shields on taking hero damage and grows while fighting.

A broad Eternal trim aimed at free value: Aion's gold (Major 6% -> 5%, Philosopher 4 -> 3.5), Krix's health (5% -> 4%), Vesh's late scaling, Construct's haste, Memory Leak, Phylactery and Furor all come down.
Valmont is cut a second straight patch, this time his ultimate's healing and damage against heroes, with a little moved into Rupture.

Maco, Kallari, Kira, Serath and Legion get help; Iggy's offlane, Morigesh, Muriel's tank builds and Steel's level-1 durability come down; Skylar's damage moves out of her Beam and missiles into the rest of her kit.
Overclocked, a limited-time mode with no mana costs, +400 ability haste and fast objectives, runs alongside ranked; none of its numbers apply to ranked.

tldr.lead: A new frontliner, and two items built for him
tldr.text: Kaelen spins, dashes and drops from the sky, and every ability lays Rimeglass that slows and burns enemies standing in it. The same patch adds Forticus and Vortex Stone, both shield-on-fight items the notes name for frontliners like Kaelen, Steel and Riktor.

tldr.lead: Free gold and free haste get trimmed
tldr.text: Aion's Major, Philosopher and Arcane Resonance all lose value, Construct drops from 1 to 0.75 ability haste per level, and Timewarp's mana regen falls from 150% to 125%. The notes say they want early leads to mean something again.

tldr.lead: Krix stops being the default bruiser Eternal
tldr.text: Max health 5% -> 4% and Predator's damage, speed and duration all shrink. The notes say jungle bruisers were skipping every other Eternal for it.
Exsanguinate's damage drops to 40/62/84 and its hero healing to 16/34/52, with lower scaling on both. Rupture gains a point of magical scaling in return.

tldr.lead: Support and jungle under-performers get pulled up
tldr.text: Maco gets more healing and shield scaling and a shorter stun, Kallari's dagger hits harder and slows more, Serath gains physical power growth and Chastise damage, and Kira's passive raven now does flat damage.

tldr.lead: The ladder resets with a new top
tldr.text: Split 5 ends on release. Placements restart for everyone, Master arrives between Diamond and Paragon with no VP cap, and Paragon becomes a live Top 100 that refreshes daily.

systems.name: Dash, leap and teleport tags fixed
systems.summary: Akeron Web Lash leap and Mourn's Abduct augment pull now count as dashes, Drongo's mid-air Shrapnel Cannon too, Kwang's ultimate teleport counts as a teleport, N3on's Erase Vector recast is a dash and his Final Thread recast a leap, and Blink, Phase's blink, Grux's and Chieftain's blink and Abyssal Dart's reactivation now count as teleports as well. Effects that check for these, such as Weald's Wind-Rider, Nihil's Inescapable and Berserker Axe or Envy, now trigger off them.

systems.name: Tower target swap fixed
systems.summary: Towers could still instantly shoot a new target the moment their current target died at certain timings. That is fixed, finishing the 1.15 targeting change.

systems.name: Attack-chain minion executes fixed
systems.summary: Heroes with variable-damage attack chains, such as Scarlett, now execute minions shown with a red health bar at their default damage modifier, instead of only on the chain hits that deal enough.

systems.name: Bug fixes that change play
systems.summary: Countess can no longer teleport back to her Shadow Slip the same frame she is crowd-controlled. Eden now keeps her ranged-stance physical power after respawning. GRIM.exe's Instant Reload now executes when an item effect such as Combustion takes the target below 5%. Howitzer's second basic attack no longer has 100% cleave on a miss. Revenant can pick up tower gold in the Nether Realm. Sevarog's Colossal Blow goes on cooldown if he is interrupted mid-swing. Legion's basic attack now executes minions at the right threshold. Kallari's double jump goes on cooldown when she is interrupted out of it. Momentum items (Rapid Rapier, Stormbreaker, Lightning Hawk, Omen) no longer fire on the attack that reaches 100 stacks.

systems.name: Overclocked (limited-time mode, not ranked)
systems.summary: A new limited-time mode with no mana or energy costs, +400 ability haste, +12% movement speed, blink on a 2-minute cooldown, much higher gold and XP, and every objective on a shorter clock. Matches run about 14 to 20 minutes. Its Renna, Sevarog, crest, item and Eternal numbers apply to this mode only.

systems.name: The Void replaces Daily Deals
systems.summary: A personal sale of 5 skins from heroes you play, each 20% to 70% off, open for 2 weeks at a time. Cosmetic only.

eternals.summary: No new Eternals. Seven Eternals are touched, and almost every change removes value the notes call free or too consistent: Aion's gold, Construct's haste, Krix's health on jungle bruisers, Vesh's late-game ramp, Knell's damage minors and Xyris's attack speed. Two quiet picks get a lift: Resonant Repair and Cull the Weak.

changes.name: Aion
changes.change: Major: gold from ability damage dealt 6% -> 5%. Philosopher gold 4 -> 3.5. Arcane Resonance cooldown progression 0.75% -> 0.6% per mana regen. Perfection ability haste above 85% health 30 -> 25.
changes.meaning: Every gold source Aion has comes down at once, and Arcane Resonance also feeds Philosopher, so the two minors shrink together. The notes say they want losing lanes to stay behind.

changes.name: Krix
changes.change: Major: max health 5% -> 4%. Predator damage amplification 10% -> 8%, movement speed 4% -> 3.5%, duration 20s -> 15s.
changes.meaning: Aimed at jungle bruisers who skip every other Eternal for Krix. The notes call it too generic and too mandatory.

changes.name: Vesh
changes.change: Major: ability damage 7% (+0.4% per minute) -> 7% (+0.35% per minute). Lich magical lifesteal 4%/7%/10%/14% -> 4%/6%/9%/12%. Phylactery cooldown progression 100% -> 75%.
changes.meaning: The early game is untouched; the cut lands after the 30-minute mark and on mid-game sustain. Phylactery is the notes' N3on example: a second full rotation came back too fast.

changes.name: Knell
changes.change: Patina shield 30 (+14 per level) -> 30 (+12 per level). Fracture damage amplification 4% (+0.2% per level) -> 3.5% (+0.2% per level). Resonant Repair healing on immobilize 3% -> 3.5% max health.
changes.meaning: The two minors that let damage heroes such as Scarlett and Eden take Knell come down; the anti-crowd-control minor goes up.

changes.name: Demiurge
changes.change: Construct ability haste per level 1 -> 0.75. Memory Leak movement speed 5% -> 4%, max mana cap 500 -> 400, mana gained from casts 5% -> 4%.
changes.meaning: Construct was 18 free haste at level 18, enough that the notes say mages were skipping haste items; it is now 13.5. Memory Leak tops out sooner and smaller.

changes.name: Xyris
changes.change: Furor total attack speed 20% -> 17.5%. Cull the Weak missing mana regen on unit kill 1% -> 1.25%.
changes.meaning: The default attack-speed minor comes down while the farming minor gets a mana lift aimed at mana-hungry laners.

changes.name: Marrow
changes.change: The Maw bonus true damage now applies below 45% max health, up from 40%.
changes.meaning: A wider execute window for carries running Marrow, who the notes say struggled with it.

items: Vortex Stone (new, support, 2350g): 375 health, 100% base health regen, 100% base mana regen, 10 ability haste. Immobilizing a hero cuts current basic cooldowns by 20% and grants a 12% max health shield for 4s (50% for ranged heroes), 12s cooldown. Recipe: Stalwart Gauntlets + Vitality Beads + Essence Ring + 100g.

Forticus (new, tank, 2900g): 325 health, 55 physical armor, 25 tenacity. Taking hero damage grants an 8% max health shield for 3.5s, 14-10s cooldown by level. Fighting heroes grows you each second for 3s: +0.6% base health, +4 movement speed, +0.5% size, stacking without limit. Recipe: Vigorous Amulet + Steel Mail + Tenacious Gem + 250g.
Judgement (crest): Thunder Cleaver total physical power scaling 30% -> 40%.
Rebirth: Mechanica cooldown 270 -> 300; resurrected heroes' camera bug fixed.
Hexbound Bracers: Hexed Guard basic attack damage block 5 (+1 per level) -> 8 (+1 per level).
Bugfixes: Stormbreaker's Electric Strike now reduces Spectra's cooldown; Infernum's damage effect now triggers Malady's Demise; Momentum items no longer fire on the attack that reaches 100 stacks.

itemChanges.name: Vortex Stone
itemChanges.change: New 2350g support item: 375 health, 100% base health and mana regen, 10 ability haste. Immobilizing a hero cuts your current basic cooldowns by 20% and shields you for 12% max health for 4s (50% for ranged heroes), on a 12s cooldown. Built from Stalwart Gauntlets, Vitality Beads and Essence Ring. The notes name Riktor, Steel and Adele.

itemChanges.name: Forticus
itemChanges.change: New 2900g physical armor tank item: 325 health, 55 physical armor, 25 tenacity. Taking hero damage grants an 8% max health shield for 3.5s (14-10s cooldown by level). Each second you fight heroes you gain 0.6% base health, 4 movement speed and 0.5% size for 3s, stacking without limit. The notes name Kaelen and Steel.

itemChanges.name: Stalwart Gauntlets
itemChanges.change: Price 1150 -> 1000. The notes call it overpriced; it is now part of Vortex Stone's recipe.

itemChanges.name: Judgement
itemChanges.change: Thunder Cleaver total physical power scaling 30% -> 40%, so the crest's burst keeps up later in the game.

itemChanges.name: Solaris
itemChanges.change: Ability haste 15 -> 10. The notes want it for TwinBlast and Kira, not as a catch-all on Eden and Yurei.

itemChanges.name: Penumbra
itemChanges.change: Cost 2900 -> 2850, physical penetration 8 -> 9. The notes call it under-bought.

itemChanges.name: Rebirth
itemChanges.change: Mechanica cooldown 270 -> 300. A camera bug on the resurrected hero is also fixed.

itemChanges.name: Magnify
itemChanges.change: Omnivamp 10% -> 8%. The notes say its healing made it feel mandatory over other anti-tank items.

itemChanges.name: Timewarp
itemChanges.change: Base mana regen 150% -> 125%. Aimed at its pairing with Aion and at greedy supports, while keeping its cooldown reduction.

itemChanges.name: Warp Stream
itemChanges.change: Tele-Blink can be used 2s after taking damage, down from 2.5s.

itemChanges.name: Hexbound Bracers
itemChanges.change: Hexed Guard basic attack damage block 5 (+1 per level) -> 8 (+1 per level). The notes name Legion, Skylar and Eden as the fast attackers it answers.

ranked.summary: Split 5 ends on release day, everyone starts the new split in placements, and the top of the ladder is rebuilt: Master is new, Paragon becomes a live Top 100, and players who stay in a game with an AFK teammate lose much less.
changes: Placements: 5 matches for everyone, 10 if you are new to ranked or have not played in a while.
Split 5 rewards: finish placements for the split icon and banner; 15 wins unlocks Royal Wukong, with Gold, Platinum, Diamond and Paragon variants by peak rank.
Master tier sits between Diamond I and Paragon. You reach it through a promotion game at the top of Diamond I, there is no VP cap, and wins and losses are +11 / -11 VP.
Paragon is the Top 100 only. At 200+ VP in Master you are eligible; the list refreshes every 24 hours and you drop back to Master if you fall out of it.
Master and Paragon have VP decay: you start Master with 10 banked days, each match banks a day up to 14, one day is used at 10:00 UTC daily, and an empty bank costs 25 VP a day.

Losing with an AFK teammate now costs 5% to 25% of a normal loss, down from 20% to 40% (a normal -18 now costs -1 to -4). A player who goes AFK and is demoted takes the AFK penalty after the demotion.

NEW HERO, melee physical frontliner. 695 health (+131), 310 mana (+60), 65 physical power (+5.2), 135 attack speed (+2.2), 36 physical armor (+4.8), 31 magical armor (+1.7), 700 movement speed, BAT 1.5.
Heart of Ice (passive): abilities leave Rimeglass for 6s. Enemies on it get Frostbite for 1s: 15% slow and 0.5% max health true damage every 0.5s.
Pale Twins (basic): melee, 325u range, 25% cleave, 65 (+80% bonus physical power).

Razorstorm (primary): spins for 3.5s, hitting every 0.25s in 400u for 7.5-17.5 (+8-16% total physical power) (+0.5-1.8% max health), laying Rimeglass. Cannot be interrupted by hard crowd control. 60% against minions. Passively +4-12% armors, x1.5 on Rimeglass. 13-8s cooldown.

Winter's Pursuit (secondary): 1100u dash that stops past the first hero, 70-170 (+100% bonus physical power) and a 25% slow for 1.2s; against a Frostbitten target damage doubles and heroes are rooted for 1.2s instead. 16-14s cooldown.
Rimefang (alternate): 0.6s channel, then a spirit flies 2250u through terrain dealing 11-15% of the target's max health, a 0.2s stun and a 50% slow for 1.5s, trailing Rimeglass. 15-13s cooldown.

Frostfall (ultimate): 1.5s channel, then 4s in the sky at 1275 movement speed, over walls and immune to damage; lands for 200/300/400 (+100% bonus physical power) (+6% bonus health), a 40% slow, a 1.5s root in the center, and an 8s Frost Storm that keeps applying Frostbite at double damage. 130/110/90s cooldown.

Augments: Relentless Hunt (Razorstorm hits once more per 20% attack speed, up to +10, and can crit; Rimeglass no longer grants armor), Neverending Chase (hits on heroes and camp leaders cut Winter's Pursuit cooldown 3%), Last Winter (allies in the landing zone get +20% movement speed; Kaelen gets a 10% max health +4% per hero hit shield).
